description: Explicit identity associations from the wiki audit; old labels of other vehicles are not treated as interchangeable aliases.

Textures/UI/ItemIcons/MortarAmmoIconFire.name: Incendiary Mortar Shell
Textures/UI/ItemIcons/MortarAmmoIconFire.reason: Retained local mortar variant: MortarAmmoIcon.png with the incendiary marker, visually reviewed. The supplied pack has only the common mortar shell; Cargo names the incendiary image MortarAmmoIconFlame.png.

Textures/UI/ItemIcons/FacilityOil1Icon.p.name: Heavy Oil
Textures/UI/ItemIcons/FacilityOil1Icon.p.reason: Visual comparison with File:HeavyOilIcon.png confirms the same triangular canister; Cargo codename FacilityOil1 independently confirms identity. Only local styling differs.

Textures/UI/ItemIcons/FacilityOil2Icon.p.name: Enriched Oil
Textures/UI/ItemIcons/FacilityOil2Icon.p.reason: Visual comparison with File:EnrichedOilIcon.png confirms the same pump canister; Cargo codename FacilityOil2 independently confirms identity. Only local styling differs.

Textures/UI/StructureIcons/FortGarrisonS.name: Underground Fortress
Textures/UI/StructureIcons/FortGarrisonS.reason: Visual comparison confirms the fortress graphic, and the local UND.FORT label plus FortGarrisonStation codename identify the deployed structure. The Underground Fortress Parts wiki page explicitly documents that it incorrectly reuses this icon.

Textures/UI/ItemIcons/FacilityMaterials4.reason: Visual comparison with AssemblyMaterials1Icon.png through AssemblyMaterials5Icon.png confirms the common sheet-metal base without their variant markers. User confirms it is generic; the historical IV label is retained only for legacy calculations. No grade or recipe is inferred.

Textures/UI/ItemIcons/MetalBeamPlatformI.reason: Visual comparison confirms File:MetalBeamPlatformItemIcon.png. The Rare Materials wiki page documents that this pallet was removed in Update 1.50 and its old icon was reused until Rare Materials received a new icon in Update 1.66. It is not associated with current Rare Materials recipes.
